mentions.name: AnyInspect
mentions.description: Inspection software for various industries that are stuck with terrible pre-2010 software or pen and paper. It uses AI where it makes sense without forcing it on users, has 5 users trialing it and helping shape the product, and is launching publicly on the app store this week.
mentions.problem: Industries are stuck with terrible pre-2010 inspection software or just pen and paper.
mentions.audience: Various industries stuck with outdated inspection software or pen and paper
